name: Game Tools
description: Helpers for the games you play, one per sidebar entry. Steam: price history, the CS2 market and a selling calculator. Roblox: Mafia role counting. Minecraft: 29 tools for players, admins and developers — enchant optimizer, shape and map art generators, guides, and command and datapack generators.

zh.name: 游戏工具
zh.description: 为你玩的游戏提供辅助工具，侧边栏每项对应一款游戏。Steam：价格历史、CS2 市场和出售计算器。Roblox：狼人杀角色统计。Minecraft：面向玩家、管理员和开发者的 29 款工具——附魔优化器、形状与地图画生成器、指南，以及命令与数据包生成器。
